summary: Join our SPSS and STATA training course tailored for M&E experts. Gain essential skills in statistical software to elevate your data analysis capabilities.
lede: Statistical software for monitoring and evaluation helps teams prepare programme data and turn it into documented evidence. Designed for M&E officers, analysts, and managers, the training covers dataset validation, indicator calculation, and descriptive analysis, hypothesis testing, and basic regression using SPSS and Stata. Learners also practise interpreting results and documenting reproducible workflows for reports and decision briefs.
audienceIntro: This SPSS and Stata training course is designed for professionals who manage monitoring datasets, analyse evaluation evidence, calculate indicators, or review statistical findings for programme decisions.
modules: M&E Foundations with SPSS and Stata
Sampling and Survey Weights in Stata
OECD DAC Analysis and Decision Briefs
prerequisites: Experience: Basic M&E, survey, indicator, or spreadsheet experience supports effective participation. Technology: You need a laptop capable of running IBM SPSS Statistics and Stata. Confirm software versions and licence arrangements before delivery. Programming: Completion requires editing statistical syntax and command files, while general-purpose coding skills remain optional. Data: Training datasets are provided. Any workplace example you bring must remove personal, confidential, and sensitive information.
